nodes.label: WhatsApp Conversion Goal
nodes.rationale: Success = click on 'Consultar por WhatsApp' with the chosen service's prefilled message; no forms or backend.

nodes.label: Home Direction Contract: Coin Toss + Glass Chooser
nodes.norm_label: home direction contract: coin toss + glass chooser
nodes.rationale: Client request 2026-09-30: the brand presents itself with one gesture (logo coin tossed once on entry), then the visitor picks auto/casa/negocio in glass panes where film completes on hover; rejects a home that opens on a single service and generic icon carousels; no WebGL 3D on the home (it lives on service pages); brief-pinned, no concept-seed.

nodes.label: Service Direction Contract: Film Applied While Scrolling
nodes.norm_label: service direction contract: film applied while scrolling
nodes.rationale: Glass goes from clear (warm interior visible) to treated (interior disappears) as the user scrolls; proof is the film demonstrated live since there are no photos/figures/testimonials; rejects the videogame 3D showroom and stock-photo carousels; stylized chrome-and-glass 3D chosen by the user on 2026-09-30 over realistic models.

nodes.label: The Clear Glass Rule
nodes.rationale: Unfilmed glass is lighter than its surroundings and shows the interior, so a film visibly darkening, mirroring or frosting the view is what makes it read as film.

nodes.label: The Film Scene Rule
nodes.rationale: Client request 2026-09-30: 3D objects are light (pearl car, light concrete facades) against the dark page so a dark film reads at a glance; red floor pool and rim light tie scenes to the home coin glow; no pedestals, lawns, props, silver paint or realistic stock models.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: Glass Under Red Light
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: glass under red light
nodes.rationale: Glass is the only translucent material and red behaves as light, so everything else stays solid, quiet and dark and the single memorable moment (film sliding across a window) reads clearly.

nodes.label: The Red Is Light Rule
nodes.rationale: Red appears only as light or action (backlight, CTA fills/glow, squeegee edge, active-nav underline, focus ring, selection); Action Red fails 4.5:1 as text on graphite.

nodes.label: Astro + Strict TypeScript Static Architecture
nodes.rationale: Static HTML by default for maximum speed and local SEO; JS only where needed (islands).

nodes.label: Build-Time Fail-Fast Validation
nodes.rationale: An invalid phone number breaks the build instead of publishing broken links; Argentine WhatsApp numbers require the mobile 9 after the country code.

nodes.label: Design System v3 Principles
nodes.rationale: One memorable moment (film on the chosen window), glass is the theme, red is light, nothing invented.

nodes.label: Nothing Invented Principle (no figures, testimonials, fake photos)
nodes.norm_label: nothing invented principle (no figures, testimonials, fake photos)
nodes.rationale: Client decision 2026-09-28: technical claims stay general with no UV/heat percentages; no job photos exist yet, so nothing is fabricated.

nodes.label: OneDrive Build Workaround (preserveSymlinks + relative tsconfig extends)
nodes.norm_label: onedrive build workaround (preservesymlinks + relative tsconfig extends)
nodes.rationale: Vite cannot resolve packages through OneDrive reparse points; astro.config.mjs uses preserveSymlinks: true and tsconfig.json extends Astro's config by relative path. Do not change; prefer moving the project out of OneDrive.

nodes.label: Red Circular Badge with White Ring
nodes.norm_label: red circular badge with white ring

nodes.label: logo.svg (primary logo)
nodes.rationale: SVG preferred, or transparent PNG >= 1000 px wide.

nodes.label: The One Family Rule
nodes.rationale: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width axis and weight, never a second family; width steps do the work a second family would.

nodes.label: Immersive Planet Portal Interaction Reference
nodes.rationale: Interaction reference pinned by the user: giant title, data rows, index with active dot, loading counter, portal to the next destination.

nodes.label: Film Materials (Smoke, Mirror, Frost, Clear Glass)
nodes.norm_label: film materials (smoke, mirror, frost, clear glass)

nodes.label: --film Custom Property (0-1)
nodes.rationale: Registered with @property as a number so CSS transitions interpolate it; script only changes state attributes.

nodes.label: StoryChapter (exactly 4)
nodes.rationale: ServiceStory fails the build unless there are exactly STORY_CHAPTER_COUNT (4) chapters because scenes are choreographed for that count.

nodes.label: The Fit-To-Word Rule
nodes.rationale: The display word scales to its own length (--title-chars) and viewport height so the longest service name never clips and the shortest never floats small.

nodes.label: The Glass Only Where Glass Is Rule
nodes.norm_label: the glass only where glass is rule
nodes.rationale: backdrop-filter blur is reserved for things that are windows (chooser panes, portal, frost swatch) because the product is glass; containers, menus and sections stay solid.

nodes.label: Squeegee Film Application (Signature Motion)
nodes.rationale: One signature motion, driven by a single 0-1 number (--film in CSS, coverage per pane in 3D), so the system shows privacy instead of naming it.

nodes.label: Render On Demand + Deferred Loading
nodes.rationale: Three.js and the model download after the page is usable (one chunk per scene); the scene only redraws on scroll/resize with damping, so there is no permanent loop draining battery; low-end devices get <=1.5x resolution and less geometry.

nodes.label: SDD Methodology (Specification-Driven Development)
nodes.rationale: Never code blindly: analyze/design first, then specify signatures, models and exceptions, then implement; ask about ambiguous edge cases before coding.

nodes.label: Specific Exception Handling / Fail-Fast Rule
nodes.rationale: No generic try/catch; catch specific exceptions and handle errors at design level (fail-fast).

nodes.label: Token Economy & Communication Style
nodes.rationale: Maximize context efficiency: no intro/closing chatter, direct answers, bullet explanations of why (not what), never repeat unchanged code.
